ALG/framework encodes this, plus the gradient-reuse reading required by the Local SGD example (line 320: the same grad f(z^{0,1}_1; eta^{0,1}_1) weights a worker edge and a main-branch edge).

Lines 2025-2033: on arrival compute delta^k = dist(w^k, z^0_{i_k}); if < B update w^{k+1} = w^k - gamma sum_p grad f(z^p_{i_k};eta^p_{i_k}) and restart the worker at w^{k+1}, else discard and restart at w^k. LocalSGDWorker(w,gamma,M) (lines 2043-2047): z^0_i = w, z^{p+1}_i = z^p_i - gamma grad f(z^p_i;eta^p_i) for p < M, send gamma sum_p grad f(z^p_i;eta^p_i). ALGAL/worker matches.
